## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] No `node_modules`, and no new dependency
- [ ] `vendor/questlaw/` is untouched, or was regenerated with `npm run vendor:sync`
- [ ] If a tool changed, `manifest.json`'s `tools` array matches what the server serves
- [ ] If the version changed, all three manifests agree and `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
- [ ] If AI was used, please note where and confirm a human reviewed all edits.
